Meet The Owner

How Probuild Started

Michael Tomkins was self employed for a number of years before he partnered up with another builder to form Probuild Property Maintenance Ltd.

Today there's a team of 8 of us, all local to Gloucestershire, covering building, tiling, painting, electrics and plumbing. We build extensions and loft conversions, carry out renovations, fit kitchens and bathrooms, take on roofing, landscaping, patios and driveways, and work for homeowners, landowners, landlords and property developers.

"There are a lot of builders that do good work and there are builders that do bad work. We do fantastic work and always take pride in everything we do."

Michael Tomkins

Why Choose Us

What Makes Us Different

  1. 01

    Planned Before We Start

    Every renovation is planned out and confirmed with you before work starts, and on bathrooms, patios, driveways and roofs you choose the materials and the look up front. Renovations.

  2. 02

    Building Control Led

    Our extensions and loft conversions go through building control, with the structural calculations done before work starts.

  3. 03

    Clear Timescales

    You know how long it should take from the start: 1 to 3 weeks for most kitchens and bathrooms, 6 to 10 weeks for a loft conversion and 8 to 14 weeks for an extension.

  4. 04

    One Team, Every Trade

    A team of 8 covering building, tiling, painting, electrics and plumbing, so one firm runs the whole job. See our services.

  5. 05

    24 Hours, With Emergency Call Out

    We're available 24 hours, with emergency call out, across Gloucester and Gloucestershire. See the areas we cover.
